description: Receipt scanner: photograph a receipt or invoice and get the shop, date, items, VAT and total as data. Uses 1 AI credit per run from an account, or US$0.50 per call paid from an agent wallet with no account. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: A photo, scan or screenshot of one receipt or invoice, base64-encoded, in the format given by type. Send this or fileId, not both. For a PDF invoice, turn the page into an image first (pdf-to-images).

fileId.description: The id of an image already uploaded to the caller's account, to read instead of data. Needs a signed-in caller; the upload is consumed by the run. Most callers should send data.

language.description: The language the receipt is most likely in, e.g. 'Danish', as a hint. Not a constraint.

type.description: The MIME type of the bytes in data: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp or image/gif.

name: receipt_scanner
title: Receipt Scanner
